answer_1.quote: We propose a generative model for paraphrase generation, that combines the diversity introduced by an explicit syntactic target with the tractability of models trained end-to-end.

answer_2.quote: Our primary metric is iBLEU , iBLEU = αBLEU(outputs, ref erences) -(1 -α)BLEU(outputs, inputs), that measures the fidelity of generated outputs to reference paraphrases as well as the level of diversity introduced. We also report BLEU(outputs, ref erences) as well as Self-BLEU(outputs, inputs). To evaluate the diversity between multiple candidates generated by the same system, we report pairwise-BLEU

answer_4.quote: In addition to automatic evaluation we elicited judgements from crowdworkers on Amazon Mechanical Turk. They were shown a sentence and two paraphrases, each generated by a different system, and asked to select which one was preferred along three dimensions: the dissimilarity of the paraphrase compared to the original sentence; how well the paraphrase reflected the meaning of the original; and the fluency of the paraphrase
answer_4.guideline: select which paraphrase is preferred along three dimensions: dissimilarity, meaning preservation, and fluency
